games.title: God of War III Remastered
games.description: God of War III Remastered (PS4) rodando no PC sem emulador, em até 4K e 60 FPS ou mais. O código x86-64 original roda direto no processador com um runtime próprio, e os gráficos usam o núcleo de vídeo do shadPS4 (Vulkan). Jogável do começo ao fim, com patch de 240 FPS, launcher em português e menu dentro do jogo.

projects.name: God of War III Remastered — FelipePrado0
systems: oct 14, 2026 catalog platform notes windows is the main packaged target; linux support is explicitly experimental.

ficha.resumo: This God of War III Remastered runtime loads the PS4 game code on PC, replaces PS4 system services and renders through a modified shadPS4 Vulkan core, with Windows and experimental Linux support.
ficha.sobre: The loader runs the original PS4 code; the runtime implements system functions and the renderer translates GPU commands to Vulkan. This is classified as a compatibility layer, despite the repository’s port terminology.
ficha.compatibilidade: layer God of War III Remastered — FelipePrado0 This God of War III Remastered runtime loads the PS4 game code on PC, replaces PS4 system services and renders through a modified shadPS4 Vulkan core, with Windows and experimental Linux support. Playable Windows · Linux Official documentation ↗ Release page ↗ Source ↗ · Artwork of the original game; it does not demonstrate this port’s compatibility.
ficha.progresso: The maintainer reports a complete playthrough at native 1080p with the 240 FPS engine setting, plus working audio, saves and remappable input. That result applies to the documented configuration and is not independently verified here.
ficha.limitacoes: The README reports broken textures at some non-native render resolutions. Its Linux section says temporal upscalers were temporarily removed. Do not assume these graphics options work in every build.
ficha.comoComecar: Use your own decrypted PS4 game folder containing eboot.bin, sce_module and sce_sys. Tested IDs are CUSA01623 and CUSA01715, versions 01.00 and 01.02. Extract the Windows release, choose that folder in the launcher and preserve its user folder when updating.
ficha.notasPlataforma: Windows is the main packaged target; Linux support is explicitly experimental.

fichaPt.resumo: Este runtime de God of War III Remastered carrega o código do jogo de PS4 no PC, substitui os serviços de sistema do PS4 e renderiza através de um núcleo Vulkan do shadPS4 modificado, com suporte para Windows e Linux experimental.
fichaPt.sobre: O carregador roda o código original de PS4; o runtime implementa as funções do sistema e o renderizador traduz comandos de GPU para Vulkan. Isso é classificado como uma camada de compatibilidade, apesar da terminologia de port do repositório.
fichaPt.compatibilidade: layer God of War III Remastered — FelipePrado0 Este runtime de God of War III Remastered carrega o código do jogão de PS4 no PC, substitui os serviços de sistema do PS4 e renderiza através de um núcleo Vulkan do shadPS4 modificado, com suporte para Windows e Linux experimental. Jogável no Windows · Linux Documentação oficial ↗ Página de releases ↗ Código-fonte ↗ · Arte do jogo original; ela não demonstra a compatibilidade deste port.
fichaPt.progresso: O desenvolvedor garante que dá pra zerar o jogo de boa em 1080p nativo travado a 240 FPS, com áudio, saves e comandos personalizados funcionando perfeitamente. Esse resultado vale só pra configuração citada, beleza? Não testamos tudo por fora.
fichaPt.limitacoes: O README avisa que as texturas podem bugar se você mexer na resolução de renderização. Na parte de Linux, diz que os upscalers temporais saíram fora por enquanto. Não vá achando que essas opções gráficas funcionam em toda build, hein!
fichaPt.comoComecar: Usa aquela sua pasta de jogo de PS4 descriptografada que vem com o eboot.bin, sce_module e sce_sys. Os IDs testados foram CUSA01623 e CUSA01715 nas versões 01.00 e 01.02. Extraia a release de Windows, selecione essa pasta no launcher e guarde bem a pasta de usuário na hora de atualizar.
fichaPt.notasPlataforma: O foco principal é o Windows; o suporte a Linux é totalmente experimental, mano.

stepsFixedPt: Tenha a sua cópia do jogo, tirada do seu próprio PS4: God of War III Remastered CUSA01623, versão 1.02. Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem no projeto.

Baixe o port: clique em Instalar e o HydraHub baixa a release oficial do GitHub (gow3-windows.zip) e extrai numa pasta. Prefere fazer na mão? O botão GitHub do port, em Links, leva pra página oficial.
Abra o God of War III.exe (botão Jogar). Se o Windows reclamar, clique em Mais informações → Executar assim mesmo.
Escolha a pasta do jogo no launcher: a pasta CUSA01623, aquela que tem o arquivo eboot.bin.
Ajuste resolução e FPS (até 4K e 120/240 FPS em Patches) e clique em JOGAR. A primeira vez demora um pouco, porque os shaders são montados.
Dentro do jogo, aperte Insert (ou R3 + L2 no controle) pra abrir o menu do port: trapaças, desempenho e contador de FPS.

games.description: O remake de Shadow of the Colossus feito pro PS4 (2018), rodando no PC. O jeito mais pronto hoje é o Pink-shadPS4, um fork do shadPS4 otimizado pra esse jogo, com launcher próprio. Também existe um port nativo de fã em andamento, com 60 FPS e saída em 4K: o guia do Achado IA mostra os dois caminhos.

stepsFixedPt: Tenha a sua cópia do remake, tirada do seu próprio PS4: CUSA08809 (versão 1.01 ou mais nova). Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem no emulador.
Baixe o Pink-shadPS4: clique em Instalar e o HydraHub baixa a release oficial do GitHub e extrai pra você.
Coloque o jogo: copie a pasta CUSA08809 (a que tem o eboot.bin) pra dentro da pasta games do emulador. Use o botão Abrir pasta.
Som: se o jogo ficar mudo, aponte os módulos de som do seu console nas configurações do launcher.
Ajuste a imagem: liga os 60 FPS e escolhe a resolução (até 4K). Placas AMD costumam rodar melhor com o upscaler FSR.
Clique em Jogar. Se fechar logo na abertura com erro de memória, aumente o arquivo de paginação do Windows: o jogo reserva uns 8 GB de uma vez.

steps: Download the stable version from its website: the nightly has the newest changes, but may break more often.
It is free on Steam, GOG and the Microsoft Store too, and some systems' package managers carry it.
It needs graphics and sounds to run: some installs fetch them for you, and the Windows installer can add the free OpenGFX, OpenSFX and OpenMSX sets.
To play with the original Transport Tycoon Deluxe graphics and sounds instead, copy sample.cat and its five TRG .grf files from your own CD, DOS or Windows, into its baseset folder.
For the original music, copy the files of the gm folder (Windows) or GM.CAT (DOS) from your own copy into the same folder.
Add more from its main menu, with Check Online Content.
stepsPt: Baixe a versão estável no site: a nightly traz as novidades mais recentes, mas pode quebrar com mais frequência.
Ele também é de graça na Steam, GOG e Microsoft Store, e alguns gerenciadores de pacotes de sistemas já vêm com ele.
Ele precisa de gráficos e sons para rodar: algumas instalações já puxam isso para você, e o instalador de Windows pode adicionar os pacotes gratuitos OpenGFX, OpenSFX e OpenMSX.
Para jogar com os gráficos e sons originais do Transport Tycoon Deluxe, copie o sample.cat e os cinco arquivos TRG .grf do seu CD, DOS ou Windows para dentro da pasta baseset.
Para a trilha sonora original, copie os arquivos da pasta gm (Windows) ou o GM.CAT (DOS) da sua cópia para a mesma pasta.
Adicione mais conteúdo direto pelo menu principal em Check Online Content.

ficha.sobre: Dusklight reimplements Twilight Princess from the zeldaret/tp decompilation, adding customization and native graphics through Aurora. It is a source port, rather than a statically translated disc executable.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use your own GameCube or Wii disc; the Korean Wii release is excluded. D3D12, Vulkan 1.1+ or Metal is recommended. The build guide documents Windows, Linux and macOS; Android has a best-effort OpenGL ES path.
ficha.progresso: The README documents disc import and multiple graphics backends. The matching decompilation foundation is GameCube even when Wii data is imported.
ficha.limitacoes: A Wii disc still produces the GameCube HUD because the matching foundation is the GameCube decompilation. D3D11 and Android OpenGL ES are fallback paths with reduced accuracy or performance; support is not a guarantee for every driver.
ficha.comoComecar: Follow the official installation guide. For a source build, initialize submodules and use the OS-specific CMake preset with CMake 3.25+ and Python 3. The documented command starts Dusklight with --dvd followed by your ISO, RVZ or other supported disc image.

steps: Check that your device can run it: a graphics card with Direct3D 12, Vulkan 1.1 or Metal; older ones get Direct3D 11, or OpenGL ES on Android, without full accuracy or speed.

Make an image of your own Twilight Princess disc, GameCube or Wii, as the article its README links explains: every commercial disc works but the Korean Wii one, and Dusklight carries none of the game.
To save space, you can turn the image of your own disc from .iso into .rvz with a program like Dolphin.
Install it as the official guide on its website explains.
With a Wii disc too, it shows the GameCube version's HUD: it is built on the GameCube decompilation.
stepsPt: Verifique se o seu dispositivo roda o jogo: placa de vídeo com Direct3D 12, Vulkan 1.1 ou Metal; versões mais antigas rodam com Direct3D 11 ou OpenGL ES no Android, mas sem a mesma precisão ou velocidade.

Crie uma imagem do seu disco de Twilight Princess (GameCube ou Wii), como explica o artigo linkado no README: qualquer disco comercial funciona, menos o do Wii coreano, e o Dusklight não inclui o jogo.
Para economizar espaço, você pode converter a imagem do seu disco de .iso para .rvz usando um programa como o Dolphin.
Instale seguindo o guia oficial no site do projeto.
Mesmo usando o disco de Wii, ele mostra a HUD da versão de GameCube, pois foi feito em cima da descompilação de GameCube.

fichaPt.progresso: A versão mais recente sem ser pré-lançamento encontrada no GitHub é a v1.0.3. Lembra que um lançamento não garante estabilidade total, jogo zerado ou suporte testado em todas as plataformas!

ficha.resumo: Unwiished Recomp is an early project aiming to recompile the Wii edition of Sonic Unleashed for PC. Its checklist marks setup and binary-analysis tools complete, while game-code recompilation, a native PC build and input support remain unfinished. Requirements and build instructions are not yet published.
ficha.sobre: This project targets the Wii edition of Sonic Unleashed and is inspired by hedge-dev’s separate Unleashed Recomp. It must not be confused with the existing Xbox 360 recompilation of the same game.
ficha.compatibilidade: PC is the intended destination, but the README has not announced operating-system requirements or a usable native build. No Windows, Linux or macOS support is asserted for this listing.
ficha.progresso: The published checklist marks project setup and binary-analysis tools complete. Wii ISO extraction/analysis, static game-code recompilation, a native PC build and controller/keyboard support remain unchecked.
ficha.limitacoes: High resolution, stable 60 FPS, keyboard/controller input and restored cut content are goals, not verified available features. The documented stage is early development.
ficha.comoComecar: The README’s requirements and build sections are still to be announced, so there is no documented installation procedure to reproduce. Follow the project for a future build guide; the author states that users must provide their own Wii game copy.

steps: You need your own Sonic Unleashed for Xbox 360, US or EU (not JP), with its title update: its Adventure Packs are optional, but recommended for the game's best lighting.
Copy the game files from your own Xbox 360, from its hard drive or a USB storage device, as the dumping guides its README links explain: the console needs no modification.
Download the project's latest release, and extract it where you want the game installed.
Run it: its installer asks for the files you copied, with Add Files for containers or images from the console, and Add Folder for a folder of the game's raw files.
It only accepts unmodified files of one region: a disc and a title update from different regions will not go together.
It needs Windows 10 or a recent Linux, a processor with AVX, and 6 to 10 GiB of space.
For mods, its README says to use Hedge Mod Manager, never to change the game's files.
stepsPt: Você vai precisar da sua própria cópia de Sonic Unleashed para Xbox 360, versão americana ou europeia (nada de versão japonesa), junto com a atualização de título (title update): os Adventure Packs são opcionais, mas super recomendados para garantir a melhor iluminação do jogo.
Copie os arquivos do jogo direto do seu Xbox 360, seja do HD interno ou de um pendrive/HD externo, seguindo os guias de extração indicados no README: o console não precisa de nenhuma modificação.
Baixe a release mais recente do projeto e extraia onde você quiser instalar o jogo.

Execute o programa: o instalador vai pedir os arquivos que você copiou. Use Add Files para arquivos de container ou imagens vindas do console, e Add Folder para uma pasta com os arquivos brutos do jogo.
Ele só aceita arquivos originais e não modificados de uma mesma região: um disco e uma atualização de regiões diferentes não vão funcionar juntos.
Você vai precisar do Windows 10 ou de uma distro Linux recente, um processador com suporte a AVX e entre 6 e 10 GiB de espaço livre.
Para usar mods, o README recomenda o Hedge Mod Manager — lembre-se de nunca alterar os arquivos originais do jogo.

steps: You need your own LEGO Island, the English version 1.1: its README shows how to check yours.
Take the rebuilt CONFIG.EXE, ISLE.EXE and LEGO1.DLL from the project's continuous release, or build them as its README explains.
Swap them for the originals in LEGO Island's install folder: by default under Program Files (x86) on 64-bit Windows, under Program Files on 32-bit.
If it reports a missing d3drm.dll (Windows has not shipped it since XP), put a copy beside the executables, as its README explains.
It runs only on Windows: for other systems and the web, its README points to isle-portable.
stepsPt: Você precisa da sua própria cópia de LEGO Island na versão 1.1 em inglês: o README mostra direitinho como verificar a sua.

Substitua os originais na pasta de instalação do LEGO Island: por padrão, fica em Program Files (x86) no Windows de 64 bits, e em Program Files no de 32 bits.
Se ele reclamar da falta da d3drm.dll (o Windows não traz mais essa DLL nativamente desde o XP), coloque uma cópia dela do lado dos executáveis, como o README ensina.
Ele roda apenas no Windows: para outros sistemas e web, o README indica o projeto isle-portable.

steps: Download ScummVM from its website and install it.
Make a folder for each game and copy into it the data files from your own original media.
Start ScummVM, choose Add game, select that folder (not the files inside it) and press Choose.
The Game Options dialog opens: the default settings are fine for now.
Select the game in the list and press Start; next time, start from there.
To add many games at once, click the small arrow on Add game and choose Mass Add: it searches every subfolder.
Its wiki lists the supported games, and its user documentation covers the rest.
stepsPt: Baixe o ScummVM no site oficial e instale.
Crie uma pasta para cada jogo e copie para dentro dela os arquivos de dados da sua própria mídia original.

A janela de Opções do Jogo vai se abrir: as configurações padrão estão boas por enquanto.
Selecione o jogo na lista e clique em Iniciar; da próxima vez, é só começar por aí.
Para adicionar vários jogos de uma vez, clique na setinha ao lado de Adicionar jogo e escolha Adicionar em Massa: ele vasculha todas as subpastas.
A wiki deles lista os jogos compatíveis, e a documentação de usuário cobre o resto.

steps: Check that your own copy is the US Mario Kart 64, the only one it supports, by the SHA-1 its README gives, and that the ROM is in .z64 format.
Download SpaghettiKart for your system from the project's releases, and extract every file into one folder.
On Windows, run Spaghettify.exe and choose your own US ROM: it makes mk64.o2r from it.
On Linux, install zenity or kdialog, then run spaghetti.appimage (you may have to make it executable with chmod +x first) and choose your own US ROM.
On a Switch, run a PC build first to make mk64.o2r, then copy the files to your SD card.
Mods go in its mods folder, as .o2r files or stored .zip files: it does not take .otr.
stepsPt: Confira se a sua cópia é a do Mario Kart 64 dos EUA (a única suportada) batendo o SHA-1 indicado no README, e se a ROM está no formato .z64.
Baixe o SpaghettiKart para o seu sistema na página de releases do projeto e extraia todos os arquivos em uma única pasta.
No Windows, execute o Spaghettify.exe e escolha sua própria ROM americana: ele vai criar o arquivo mk64.o2r a partir dela.
No Linux, instale o zenity ou o kdialog, execute o spaghetti.appimage (talvez você precise dar permissão de execução com chmod +x primeiro) e escolha sua própria ROM americana.
No Switch, rode a versão de PC primeiro para gerar o mk64.o2r e depois copie os arquivos para o seu cartão SD.
Os mods ficam na pasta mods, como arquivos .o2r ou .zip compactados: ele não aceita .otr.

ficha.resumo: Melee project with a decompilation-based Source Port and a separate Static Recomp engine. Uses your NTSC 1.02 ISO, supports Slippi integration and separates 60 Hz game logic from display rendering; current releases also include Linux.
ficha.sobre: The main Source Port compiles Melee’s C decompilation into a native library. A second Static Recomp engine translates the retail PowerPC code ahead of time for mods needing the original code. Both use a native runtime; this profile explicitly distinguishes the two.
ficha.compatibilidade: Supply your own Melee NTSC 1.02 ISO. Windows documentation covers D3D12 and a D3D11 fallback without DLSS. The v0.9.15 release also publishes a Linux x86-64 archive; use its included README for platform-specific adapter setup.
ficha.progresso: The current release is v0.9.15, newer than the version line retained in the README. Its notes fix a Static Recomp crash in long online Teams sessions. Display interpolation is documented separately from the game’s fixed 60 Hz simulation.
ficha.limitacoes: Engine choice matters for mods: documented training mods target Source Port, while Akaneia uses Static Recomp and matching Direct builds. Experimental graphics paths and native DualShock 4 handling are not universal guarantees. D3D11 does not provide DLSS.
ficha.comoComecar: For Windows, use the current release ZIP and supply your NTSC 1.02 ISO through the optional launcher or documented batch-file workflow. For Linux v0.9.15, extract the Linux archive and run ./MeleeUnlocked; follow its README for the GameCube adapter.

projects.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild — Savage Wind Recomp

ficha.resumo: Alpha static recompilation of Switch Breath of the Wild 1.8.2 for Windows x64. Requires your own extracted game, AVX2 and Vulkan 1.3. Only the opening and Great Plateau are documented as tested; the rest remains unverified.
ficha.sobre: Savage Wind Recomp is an unofficial static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, based on LAS Recomp. It recompiles the Switch game code locally from the player’s own extracted files and reimplements the required console services; it supplies no game data, keys or firmware.
ficha.compatibilidade: The downloadable Alpha 2 targets Windows 10 or newer, x86-64 with AVX2, a Vulkan 1.3 GPU and about 35 GB free disk space. It accepts only the Nintendo Switch version 1.8.2: ExeFS files main, main.npdm, rtld, sdk and subsdk0 plus the complete RomFS with the base game and update merged.
ficha.progresso: Public release v0.2.0-alpha.2 was published on 2026-10-22. The maintainer reports the opening in the Shrine of Resurrection and the Great Plateau running with sound, voices, HUD, saving and loading. No playthrough beyond that area is documented.
ficha.limitacoes: This is an alpha preview for testers. Areas beyond the Great Plateau may crash or render incorrectly. The maintainer reports drops to 45–50 FPS during real play and stutters on the first occurrence of an effect while its pipeline is created; 60 FPS is not a universal performance guarantee.
ficha.comoComecar: Download the Windows Alpha 2 ZIP from the official Releases page and extract it into a writable folder outside Program Files. Run savagewind.exe, select your extracted exefs/ and romfs/ folder for version 1.8.2, then choose Set up game files. It checks and copies the data, builds the image and recompiles the code locally before starting.

steps: It needs your own Xbox 360 copy of Skate 3: none of the game files ship with it.
On Windows, download Skate3Recomp-Windows.zip from its latest release, extract it into a folder you control and run skate3.exe.
Click Select ISO, choose your own copy of Skate 3, wait while it extracts the game files, then click Start Game.
On Linux, do the same with Skate3Recomp-Linux.zip and run skate3; on some hardware, the Windows build through Proton plays better.
On macOS (Apple silicon, experimental), keep the skate3recomp app in a folder you control, not Downloads or Applications: it keeps your own game files, its saves and its settings beside it.
The first time on macOS, right-click the app and choose Open, or approve it in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
Windows is the most tested, then Linux, then macOS.
For DLC, put the package files of your own Xbox 360 DLC in a dlc folder beside the executable.
For a portable install, create an empty portable.txt beside the executable.
Escape on the keyboard, or RB and Start on a controller, opens its settings.

Na primeira vez no macOS, clique com o botão direito no aplicativo e escolha Abrir, ou aprove-o em Ajustes do Sistema > Privacidade e Segurança.
O Windows é o sistema mais testado, seguido por Linux e macOS.
Para DLCs, coloque os arquivos de pacote da sua DLC de Xbox 360 em uma pasta dlc ao lado do executável.
Para uma instalação portátil, crie um arquivo vazio chamado portable.txt ao lado do executável.
Aperte Esc no teclado, ou RB e Start no controle, para abrir as configurações.

ficha.sobre: The project credits the Paper Mario decompilation and Paper Mario DX teams and uses libultraship. It is a source port of the Nintendo 64 game.
ficha.compatibilidade: The quick-start guide covers Windows, Linux AppImage and macOS. Renderer choices are DirectX 11 on Windows, OpenGL across platforms and Metal on macOS; changing renderer requires a restart.

ficha.limitacoes: The documented ROM is the US release with SHA-1 3837f44cda784b466c9a2d99df70d77c322b97a0. The README does not establish support for other regional dumps.

projects.name: Animal Crossing PC Port - Deluxe Edition

steps: It needs your own disc image of Animal Crossing, the USA release (GAFE01, Rev 0), as ISO, GCM or CISO.
Download the zip of its latest release and extract it.
Put your own disc image in its rom folder and run AnimalCrossing.exe: it reads everything from the image at startup, with nothing to extract first.
On the keyboard, WASD moves, the arrow keys turn the camera, Space is A, Left Shift is B and Enter is Start; keybindings.ini rebinds them.
SDL2 gamepads work, detected when plugged in.
Saves go in its save folder as GCI files: put a Dolphin GCI export there to bring an existing save.
Resolution (up to 4K), fullscreen, VSync and MSAA are in its options menu or in settings.ini.
stepsPt: Ele precisa da sua própria imagem de disco de Animal Crossing, versão dos EUA (GAFE01, Rev 0), nos formatos ISO, GCM ou CISO.

Coloque sua própria imagem de disco na pasta rom do jogo e execute AnimalCrossing.exe: ele lê tudo direto da imagem ao iniciar, sem precisar extrair nada antes.
No teclado, WASD move, as setas direcionais giram a câmera, Espaço é A, Shift Esquerdo é B e Enter é o Start; você pode remapear tudo no arquivo keybindings.ini.
Controles compatíveis com SDL2 funcionam e são detectados automaticamente ao serem conectados.
Os saves ficam na pasta save como arquivos GCI: coloque uma exportação GCI do Dolphin lá se quiser trazer um save existente.
Resolução (até 4K), tela cheia, VSync e MSAA ficam no menu de opções ou no arquivo settings.ini.

steps: It needs the data files of your own Cave Story: the freeware release, Cave Story+, or the Switch remaster.
Download a stable or beta build from its releases, or a nightly build; on Linux it is also a Flatpak.
With the freeware, put it in the same folder as Doukutsu.exe: at the first start it extracts what it needs into a data folder, and both must stay there until then.
With Cave Story+, run it in place of CaveStory+.exe; nothing in the game's folder changes.
With the Epic Games Store copy, first delete the stray opengl32.dll from the game's folder, or it crashes at startup.
The arrows move, Z jumps, X shoots, A and S cycle weapons, Q opens the inventory and W the map; Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen.
On macOS, if it can't be opened, right-click doukutsu-rs.app and choose Open.
The 2026 Steam release of the remaster is not supported yet.
stepsPt: Ele precisa dos arquivos de dados do seu próprio Cave Story: a versão gratuita (freeware), o Cave Story+ ou a remasterização do Switch.

No caso da versão gratuita, coloque-a na mesma pasta do Doukutsu.exe: na primeira inicialização, ele extrai o que precisa para uma pasta data, e ambos devem permanecer juntos até lá.
No Cave Story+, execute no lugar de CaveStory+.exe; nada na pasta do jogo muda.
Com a cópia da Epic Games Store, primeiro apague o arquivo opengl32.dll perdido na pasta do jogo, senão ele fecha sozinho ao iniciar.
As setas movem, Z pula, X atira, A e S trocam de arma, Q abre o inventário e W o mapa; Alt+Enter alterna a tela cheia.
No macOS, se não abrir, clique com o botão direito em doukutsu-rs.app e escolha Abrir.
O lançamento de 2026 da remasterização ainda não é compatível.

steps: It needs your own clean, unmodified disc image of Mario Kart Wii, the PAL version (RMCP01), dumped from your own disc: other regions and patched copies are refused.
The easy way is Wheel Wizard: pick your own image under Settings, turn on WiiCompiled (beta) and click install on the Home page; it then installs, updates and launches the game.
On macOS, download WiiCompiled-Setup.pkg from its releases and open it, then open WiiCompiled Setup in Applications and choose your own disc image.
Setup translates and compiles the game on your machine, a one-time wait; on Windows, keep about 20 GB free during the install (the game then takes about 5 GB).
On macOS, it may first ask to install the Xcode Command Line Tools: finish Apple's installer, then open Setup again.
Press F10 in the game's window for its settings: resolution, controllers and button mapping, vibration, volume.
Take its builds only from its releases page, never from an installer shared elsewhere.
stepsPt: Precisa da sua própria imagem de disco limpa e não modificada de Mario Kart Wii, versão PAL (RMCP01), copiada direto do seu disco: outras regiões e cópias modificadas serão recusadas.
O jeito mais fácil é usar o Wheel Wizard: escolha sua imagem em Settings, ative o WiiCompiled (beta) e clique em install na página inicial; aí ele instala, atualiza e abre o jogo.
No macOS, baixe o WiiCompiled-Setup.pkg nos releases e abra-o, depois abra o WiiCompiled Setup em Applications e escolha sua imagem de disco.
O Setup traduz e compila o jogo na sua máquina, o que exige uma espera única; no Windows, deixe cerca de 20 GB livres durante a instalação (depois o jogo ocupa uns 5 GB).
No macOS, pode ser que ele peça primeiro para instalar o Xcode Command Line Tools: termine o instalador da Apple e abra o Setup de novo.
Pressione F10 na janela do jogo para acessar as configurações: resolução, controles e mapeamento de botões, vibração e volume.
Baixe as versões apenas na página de releases, nunca por um instalador compartilhado em outros lugares.

steps: Download the build for your system from its latest release: Linux (x64 or arm64), macOS, or Windows (x64 or x86).
It ships no game content: it needs the data of your own Carmageddon, from its CD or the Max Pack bought on GOG.
It also plays the freeware demos of Carmageddon and of its Splat Pack.
Put it in the top-level Carmageddon folder, the one with CARMA.EXE; on Windows, put SDL2.dll there too.
To keep the game in another folder, or change other settings, write a dethrace.ini file.
If the Carmageddon folder holds a MUSIC folder of Track02.ogg, Track03.ogg and so on, as GOG's copy does, it plays them in place of the CD's music.
stepsPt: Baixe a versão para o seu sistema na página de releases mais recente: Linux (x64 ou arm64), macOS ou Windows (x64 ou x86).

Ele também roda as demos gratuitas do Carmageddon e do seu Splat Pack.
Coloque-o na pasta principal do Carmageddon, aquela com o CARMA.EXE; no Windows, coloque o SDL2.dll lá também.
Para manter o jogo em outra pasta ou alterar outras configurações, crie um arquivo dethrace.ini.
Se a pasta do GameManager tiver uma pasta MUSIC com Track02.ogg, Track03.ogg e assim por diante, como na cópia da GOG, ele toca esses arquivos no lugar da música do CD.

Outlaws is not playable yet: its support is planned for version 2.0.
On Windows, download its release package from the downloads page of its website: it holds the program and everything it needs but the game.
On most Linux systems, install it as a Flatpak from Flathub; on the Steam Deck, in desktop mode, through KDE's Discover.
Mods go in its Mods folder, as zip files or folders.
Its menus need a mouse or a touchscreen for now.
For the feel of DOS, play in 320x200, set the mouse to menus only or horizontal in the input menu, and turn on the classic software renderer.
It needs OpenGL 3.3, on 64-bit Windows 7, a modern Linux or macOS.
stepsPt: Ele roda Star Wars: Dark Forces usando a sua própria cópia comprada do jogo original, que ele não inclui; a documentação te explica como comprar uma legalmente.
Outlaws ainda não roda: o suporte tá nos planos pra versão 2.0.
No Windows, baixe o pacote de lançamento lá na página de downloads do site: ele vem com o programa e tudo o que precisa, só faltando o jogo mesmo.
Na maioria das distros Linux, é só instalar como Flatpak pelo Flathub; no Steam Deck, no modo desktop, vai pelo Discover do KDE.
Jogue os mods na pasta Mods, seja em formato zip ou como pastas normais.
Por enquanto, os menus pedem um mouse ou uma tela sensível ao toque.
Pra dar aquela vibe nostálgica de DOS, jogue em 320x200, configure o mouse só pro menu ou na horizontal no menu de input, e ative o renderizador de software clássico.
Ele precisa de OpenGL 3.3, rodando num Windows 7 de 64 bits, Linux atualizado ou macOS.

projects.name: woof
systems: oct 11, 2026 catalog platform notes windows / linux / macos

ficha.resumo: A modern Doom source port derived from MBF, with widescreen rendering, modern controllers and multiple compatibility levels.
ficha.sobre: Woof continues Lee Killough’s MBF through the WinMBF codebase, focusing on quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes and compatibility with modern systems.
ficha.compatibilidade: Documented compatibility levels are Vanilla, Boom, MBF and MBF21; MBF21 is the default. A mod’s required engine features should be checked against these capabilities.
ficha.progresso: The project documents adoption of DEHEXTRA, DSDHacked, UMAPINFO and MBF21 and links a changelog for changes in progress since the latest release.
ficha.limitacoes: UDMF support is documented for the Doom namespace and specification version 1.1. This statement does not imply compatibility with every UDMF map or with other source ports’ scripting extensions.
ficha.comoComecar: The official release page offers Windows binaries targeting Windows 7 or newer and Linux AppImages. The README links an official Getting Started guide for game setup.

fichaPt.resumo: Um source port moderno de Doom baseado no MBF, com suporte a proporção widescreen, controles modernos e vários níveis de compatibilidade.
fichaPt.sobre: O Woof dá continuidade ao MBF de Lee Killough usando a base de código do WinMBF, focando em melhorias de qualidade de vida, correção de bugs e compatibilidade com sistemas modernos.
fichaPt.compatibilidade: Os níveis de compatibilidade documentados são Vanilla, Boom, MBF e MBF21; o MBF21 vem como padrão. Vale a pena conferir se os recursos de engine que o seu mod exige batem com essas compatibilidades.
fichaPt.progresso: O projeto documenta a adoção de DEHEXTRA, DSDHacked, UMAPINFO e MBF21, e traz um link para o changelog com as novidades que estão rolando desde o último release.
fichaPt.limitacoes: O suporte ao UDMF está documentado para o namespace do Doom e a versão de especificação 1.1. Isso não garante compatibilidade com todo mapa UDMF ou com as extensões de script de outros source ports.
fichaPt.comoComecar: A página oficial de release traz binários para Windows 7 ou mais recente e AppImages para Linux. O README traz o link para um guia de introdução oficial para configurar o jogo.

ficha.resumo: Experimental static AArch64-to-C recompilation of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, with a Windows x64 runtime, Direct3D 11 renderer and Local Wireless relay. The alpha runtime targets game 11.0.0; Linux support is an experimental source build.
ficha.sobre: WindowSmash translates the game’s AArch64 CPU code to C ahead of time and links it with a custom runtime for operating-system services, graphics, input, audio and networking.
ficha.compatibilidade: The alpha runtime targets game 11.0.0 on Windows 10/11 x64, an AVX2/FMA/F16C CPU and a Direct3D 11 GPU. Linux x64 is experimental, cross-compiled from the source with DXVK, Vulkan and SDL2; it is not the Windows download.
ficha.progresso: Public GitHub release checked: v0.1.0-alpha.1 (prerelease), published 2026-10-18T00:52:10Z. Publication does not certify stability or complete gameplay.
ficha.limitacoes: This is a prerelease with one local player per instance. Complete two-PC matches and the full fighter/stage roster are not comprehensively verified; shader compilation can cause hitches. It has no Nintendo online-service integration and requires your own matching game data and firmware fonts.
ficha.comoComecar: For Windows, extract the runtime package, use Configure Game Data.bat to select your own compatible RomFS and fonts, then Play SSBU.bat. Consult the separate README-LINUX.md for the experimental Linux build.
ficha.notasPlataforma: Windows: alpha runtime download. Linux: experimental source build, not a prebuilt release.

fichaPt.resumo: Recompilação estática experimental de AArch64 para C de Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, com um runtime para Windows x64, renderizador Direct3D 11 e retransmissão de rede local (Local Wireless). O runtime alfa é voltado para a versão 11.0.0 do jogo; o suporte ao Linux é uma compilação experimental a partir do código-fonte.
fichaPt.sobre: O WindowSmash traduz o código da CPU AArch64 do jogo para C de forma antecipada (AOT) e junta tudo com um runtime customizado para lidar com sistema operacional, gráficos, controles, áudio e rede.
fichaPt.compatibilidade: O runtime alfa roda o jogo na versão 11.0.0 no Windows 10/11 x64, exigindo uma CPU com AVX2/FMA/F16C e uma placa de vídeo compatível com Direct3D 11. A versão para Linux x64 é experimental, compilada direto do código-fonte com DXVK, Vulkan e SDL2 — ou seja, não é o download pronto do Windows.
fichaPt.progresso: Lançamento público no GitHub verificado: v0.1.0-alpha.1 (versão prévia), publicada em 18/10/2026. Essa publicação não garante estabilidade nem que o jogo roda do começo ao fim.
fichaPt.limitacoes: Essa é uma versão prévia que suporta um jogador local por instância. Partidas entre dois PCs e a seleção completa de lutadores e fases ainda não foram totalmente testadas, e a compilação de shaders pode dar umas travadinhas. O app não tem integração com os serviços online da Nintendo e exige que você traga os seus próprios dados do jogo e fontes de firmware.
fichaPt.comoComecar: No Windows, extraia o pacote de runtime, use o Configure Game Data.bat para selecionar seus próprios RomFS e fontes compatíveis, e depois abra o Play SSBU.bat. Consulte o arquivo README-LINUX.md separado para a compilação experimental no Linux.
fichaPt.notasPlataforma: Windows: download do runtime alfa. Linux: build experimental a partir do código-fonte, sem instalador pronto.

ficha.resumo: Native SSBU recompilation project for game versions 13.0.4/13.0.5. Windows has the main installer; Linux is an experimental native build. Local Wireless networking is experimental and rollback remains in progress, not a finished online feature.
ficha.sobre: OpenSmash-Ultimate is the current project name; ssbu-recomp is its repository name. It translates AArch64 game code to native C and implements console services with a Vulkan renderer and an OpenGL fallback on Windows.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use your own SSBU dump with update 13.0.4 or 13.0.5. The Windows path specifies Windows 10/11 x64 and Vulkan 1.3; the installation prepares data and code locally. It does not include the game or console keys.
ficha.progresso: The maintainer documents complete scripted 1v1 matches to the results screen, initial play in some modes and an experimental Local Wireless network layer. Public prerelease assets are runtime components used by the installer, not a bundled finished game.
ficha.limitacoes: Rollback netcode is still in progress; it must not be advertised as available. World of Light only reached the intro, several multiplayer modes remain untested, and controller tests largely use virtual devices. Source-coverage percentages are not percentages of game completion.
ficha.comoComecar: On Windows, download the repository and use Install SSBU.bat to check your system and locate your own game/update data. The installer obtains its runtime and prepares game libraries locally; Play SSBU.bat starts the result.

ficha.resumo: Bayonetta 2 Switch code rebuilt locally for PC from your extracted v1.2 dump. Windows is the main path and Linux remains a test builder. The launcher manages builds, controls and mods; later chapters and broader hardware coverage remain under testing.
ficha.sobre: B2recomp statically translates AArch64 into C locally and runs it with reimplemented Switch system services and an NVN-to-Vulkan renderer. Downloads are source/builder tools, not a ready-made game DLL.
ficha.compatibilidade: Supply your extracted Bayonetta 2 v1.2 dump with update v131072 applied, using plain exefs/ and romfs/. Encrypted NSP/XCI/NCA inputs are refused. Windows 10/11 x64 and Vulkan 1.3 are documented; a separate Linux builder is still in testing.
ficha.progresso: The official stable builder release is v0.2.7. The README reports prologue and early Chapter 1 testing on the developer’s PC and ongoing testing of later chapters. It does not establish a fully validated campaign.
ficha.limitacoes: The Windows renderer has workarounds for missing AMD Polaris driver features; first-run shader compilation can hitch. The optional mode above 60 FPS is beta and some effects/menus can run faster. Linux testing and broad hardware coverage are not equivalent to the main Windows path.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the official builder to its own folder, start B2recomp.exe, select your permanent extracted dump folder and choose Build. After local generation and compilation, set controls and video options and use Play.
ficha.notasPlataforma: Windows is the primary documented target. The separate Linux builder is explicitly in testing, not a stable Linux compatibility guarantee.

ficha.resumo: Switch homebrew adaptation of BM64Recomp using N64Recomp and libultraship/OpenGL. Accepts your USA ROM and offers NRO/NSP packages, saves and a PT-BR translation; applet mode and executable code mods are not supported.
ficha.sobre: BM64Switch adapts RevoSucks/BM64Recomp through N64Recomp and N64ModernRuntime. It replaces the desktop RT64 renderer with libultraship Fast3D over OpenGL and uses an ImGui settings menu specific to this Switch port.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use a Switch with Atmosphère and your own Bomberman 64 USA ROM. The runtime accepts .z64, .n64 and .v64 byte orders and validates/copies the ROM on first launch. Other game regions are not documented as supported.
ficha.progresso: Official v1.0.0 provides NRO and NSP packages. The maintainer shows real Switch OLED photos and documents sound, saves, rumble and PT-BR menus plus 33 Adventure conversations; this records the project’s evidence, not a new AllRecomps console test.
ficha.limitacoes: Album/applet mode lacks enough memory: launch NRO in title override. Code mods do not work because this homebrew cannot create executable memory. First-time shader compilation can hitch; graphical stage/world titles remain English even with Portuguese enabled.
ficha.comoComecar: For the NRO route, copy the official BM64Recompiled NRO to sdmc:/switch/ and start Homebrew Menu in title override by holding R while opening a game. Put your USA ROM under sdmc:/switch/bm64recomp/, sdmc:/switch/ or the SD root.

fichaPt.comoComecar: Para o método NRO, copie o NRO oficial do BM64Recompiled para sdmc:/switch/ e abra o Homebrew Menu em modo de substituição de título (segurando R ao abrir qualquer jogo). Coloque sua ROM americana (USA) em sdmc:/switch/bm64recomp/, sdmc:/switch/ ou na raiz do cartão SD.

ficha.compatibilidade: Use your own European BCES00220 dump as an ISO or a folder containing PS3_GAME. An encrypted disc image requires its matching local .dkey; if only EBOOT.BIN exists, the documented setup uses RPCS3 to decrypt the executable.

ficha.comoComecar: Run the official Setup, select your ISO or PS3_GAME folder, choose an installation directory and press Install. It checks dependencies, imports your data and builds locally; an interrupted run can resume completed steps.

ficha.resumo: Experimental Windows NESRecomp project with expanded horizontal-stage scenery, controller settings and five save-state slots. Uses your compatible .nes ROM; native translation has a documented boundary fallback and full-game coverage is not established.
ficha.sobre: Mushroom Recompiled uses NESRecomp to translate 6502 code into native C, with PPU/APU/DMA/MMC3 timing provided by the runtime. The source documentation identifies the SMB3 integration and cycle seeds; the project’s chosen presentation name is Mushroom Recompiled.
ficha.compatibilidade: The portable application targets Windows x64 and asks for a compatible .nes ROM through its file selector. The public README does not establish compatibility with every regional revision or a certified minimum hardware configuration.
ficha.progresso: The current v1.5.0-exp package is explicitly experimental. A 3000-frame test reports matching state hashes against interpreted execution under the same hardware model, with almost all sampled cycles native; this does not validate all stages or equivalence with a physical console.
ficha.limitacoes: An instruction crossing a bank boundary uses interpreted fallback. Widescreen expands supported horizontal scenes and object activation; vertical rooms, bonuses and unsupported scenes keep native framing. Do not describe it as universal widescreen or a fully completed port.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the entire official experimental ZIP and run MushroomRecompiled.exe. Choose Select ROM and your compatible .nes. Future launches remember that file; a missing or incompatible remembered file returns to the launcher.

projects.name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005) — SpeedBreaker
systems: linux, steamos, steam deck, macos, ios, ipados source ↗

ficha.resumo: Xbox 360 Most Wanted recompiled for Linux/SteamOS and Apple Silicon Macs, with experimental iPhone/iPad builds. Requires your own USA disc. Includes widescreen rendering, an installer and graphics controls; Windows and Android remain planned.
ficha.sobre: SpeedBreaker translates the Xbox 360 PowerPC program ahead of time using XenonRecomp, with a runtime derived from Unleashed Recompiled and Xenia research. It targets the console release, not the Windows PC edition. Documented features include up-to-4K scaling, aspect-correct ultrawide/tall screens, FSR 1 and configurable input.
ficha.compatibilidade: Requires your own USA NTSC-U English Xbox 360 disc as full ISO, trimmed XISO or extracted folder, about 7.2 GB free, and no title update. Linux/SteamOS x86-64 requires AVX2 and Vulkan 1.2; Macs require Apple Silicon and macOS 15+. There is no Intel Mac package.
ficha.progresso: Release v0.1.7 improves 60 FPS pacing on 120/180/240 Hz Linux/SteamOS displays and adds a notice for uneven refresh multiples. The maintainer tested the pacing change on simulated high-refresh displays, not a physical 120 Hz panel. These are display-pacing fixes, not 120–240 FPS gameplay.
ficha.limitacoes: Windows, Android and SpeedBreaker: Carbon are planned, not downloadable supported games/platforms. The IPA had not been installed on a real device in the v0.1.7 notes; sideloading entitlement limits can prevent launch or cause memory-related exits. ARM64 support is not established for arbitrary Linux devices.
ficha.comoComecar: Choose the official x86-64 SteamOS archive for Deck/Linux, arm64 archive for Frame, or Apple Silicon DMG for Mac. Linux starts through speedbreaker.sh, which loads the bundled libraries; the bare executable can fail. Add it as a non-Steam game with Proton disabled. On first launch select your own disc and let the installer check/copy all 49 files.

fichaPt.comoComecar: Escolha o arquivo oficial do SteamOS x86-64 para Deck/Linux, o arquivo arm64 para Frame ou o DMG da Apple Silicon para Mac. O Linux roda pelo speedbreaker.sh, que carrega as bibliotecas inclusas; o executável puro pode falhar. Adicione como um jogo não-Steam com o Proton desativado. ficha.resumo: Mega Man X SNESRecomp integration with adaptive widescreen, optional Zero and X2/X3 weapons, local co-op and netplay. Requires the USA Rev 1 base ROM; character and weapon mods need additional compatible ROMs supplied by the user.
ficha.sobre: This per-game SNESRecomp project combines translated 65816 game code and a shared hardware runtime. Optional mods add Zero styles, imported weapons and co-op; the Windows HLE frame compositor is a host presentation optimization, not a change to game simulation speed.
ficha.compatibilidade: The base is Mega Man X USA Rev 1 (v1.1), CRC32 DED53C64; the original USA v1.0 is refused. Zero/co-op/X3 weapons require a Mega Man X3 USA ROM, and X2 weapons require Mega Man X2 USA. Assets are extracted locally.
ficha.progresso: The observed release is v2.3.0 with Windows and Linux packages. The README documents available adaptive view, Zero, local co-op, netplay and Boss Rush; optional features retain their own validation notes and are not a blanket guarantee for every mod combination.
ficha.limitacoes: Do not use translated, hacked or MSU-1-prepatched ROMs as the base. Add Zero and X/Zero Co-op are alternatives. Netplay uses original or fixed aspect ratios rather than every arbitrary adaptive width. Performance figures in the README describe a specific measured route, not all PCs.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the Windows ZIP or make the Linux AppImage executable, select your USA Rev 1 ROM and configure Controls. Enable only the desired Mods; select your additional USA X2/X3 ROMs when those mods request them.

ficha.sobre: Built on XboxXBERecomp, the project statically recompiles the original Xbox game and provides a PC runtime, launcher, input mapping and graphics settings. The base game is not included.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use your own USA or Europe Xbox copy as ISO, XISO, ZIP, extracted folder or default.xbe. Requirements specify x64 SSE4.2/POPCNT, Windows 10 1903+ or Linux glibc 2.38+, and Direct3D 12 or Vulkan 1.3; Vulkan 1.2 needs dynamic rendering.
ficha.progresso: The maintainer reports a completed campaign playthrough. Release 0.2.0 adds Linux support, a Krypt mod catalog and a Brazilian Portuguese text/subtitle/dubbing LanguagePack. These reports are not independent certification across every machine.
ficha.limitacoes: Some graphics glitches remain. The bundled Mortal Kombat II and The Suffering Demo are not supported; their support is planned, not available. Language-pack availability is separate from the original game files.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the official package for your system, open its executable, select your image or full game folder and choose Save and Play. ISO/XISO are read directly; ZIP contents are imported once. Keep the selected data available.

ficha.compatibilidade: Supply your own PC installation with sh3.exe of 3,338,240 bytes, SHA-1 aa2aca6dba19bf510c9c2e92eefdc15e98266581, and its data folder of about 5 GB. The required input is not the PS2 disc.
ficha.progresso: The README documents a release NRO, controller remapping, shader caching and source builds. The Linux path is primarily used for debugging, separate from Switch deployment.
ficha.limitacoes: First visits can stutter while shaders compile into sh3-progs.bin. Widescreen gameplay expands the view while menus/HUD keep a centered 4:3 region; this is not a claim that every element becomes ultrawide or every area has been tested.
ficha.comoComecar: Place the official NRO, sh3.exe, data/ and an empty savedata/ in /switch/sh3-nx/. Launch Homebrew Menu in title takeover by holding R while starting an installed game; applet/Album mode lacks memory. Keep saves and shader cache beside the NRO.

games.description: Rust-based PC port of the original PS2 Ratchet & Clank, generated from your PAL or USA disc. Includes optional modern camera and graphics, keyboard/mouse controls and in-place updates; the maintainer reports a complete playthrough.

ficha.resumo: Rust-based PC port of the original PS2 Ratchet & Clank, generated from your PAL or USA disc. Includes optional modern camera and graphics, keyboard/mouse controls and in-place updates; the maintainer reports a complete playthrough.
ficha.sobre: Setup translates the original PS2 code into native Rust and runs it with the project’s Rust CPU core. Graphics, sound, movies, input and saving are implemented by the PC runtime; selected original functions are rewritten for fixes and optional PC features.
ficha.compatibilidade: Accepted discs are PAL/Europe v1.00 SCES-50916 and USA v1.00 SCUS-97199. Japan, Platinum and Greatest Hits are not supported. Windows 10/11 x64, about 5 GB free and internet for initial tools are documented.
ficha.progresso: The maintainer reports start-to-credits play and New Game+. Release v0.3.0 adds graphics quality pages, optional illumination and frame smoothing while retaining original simulation timing; these are project reports, not an AllRecomps gameplay test.
ficha.limitacoes: The USA edition has less testing than PAL. A faint Thruster-Pack afterimage is missing and some glass can flicker. Optional graphics and smoothing can change rendering cost; no universal hardware or frame-rate guarantee is inferred.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the official rac-rs ZIP, run Setup.cmd, choose the ISO of your supported disc and click Install. Setup obtains private Rust/Python/assembler tools in its own folder, validates the disc, generates code and creates a desktop shortcut.

fichaPt.resumo: Port para PC em Rust do Ratchet & Clank original de PS2, gerado a partir do seu disco PAL ou USA. Inclui câmera e gráficos modernos opcionais, controles de teclado/mouse e atualizações diretas; o mantenedor relata que é possível zerar o jogo completo.
fichaPt.comoComecar: Extraia o ZIP oficial do rac-rs, execute o Setup.cmd, escolha a ISO do seu disco compatível e clique em Instalar. O Setup baixa ferramentas privadas em Rust/Python/assembler na pasta dele, valida o disco, gera o código e cria um atalho na área de trabalho.

ficha.resumo: rac1-native-game ports the original PS2 code function by function to C++, including vector-unit work, with an OpenGL renderer. This is a source port rather than the separate Rust/static translation projects.
ficha.sobre: rac1-native-game ports the original PS2 code function by function to C++, including vector-unit work, with an OpenGL renderer. This is a source port rather than the separate Rust/static translation projects.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use your North American SCUS-97199 ISO or newly supported European SCES-50916 disc. Windows and Linux need OpenGL 4.6. PAL support is new and awaits testing; the main documented hardware tests are on an Ubuntu/AMD laptop.
ficha.progresso: The maintainer reports all planets through Drek/credits on v0.4.0 and a New Game+ opening check, with one executed-code function still to port. This is not a numeric full-game completion metric.
ficha.limitacoes: Later planets have only one documented complete playthrough and the port still needs polish. PAL mapping is untested. Source changes after the current release, such as launcher/lighting/audio work, should not be presented as shipped features of that release.
ficha.comoComecar: For v0.4.0 follow manual setup.sh --iso on Linux or setup.cmd then play.cmd on Windows. The README describes a new launcher on main but explicitly says the v0.4.0 release lacks it. Use release-specific instructions rather than assuming future launcher assets exist.

ficha.resumo: An early static recompilation of Forza Horizon 2 for Xbox 360 using the vendored ReXGlue SDK. The tested Windows AMD64 build reaches a loading screen but stalls on a kernel semaphore before gameplay. It is a development project, not a working PC release.
ficha.sobre: The repository combines recompilation metadata, build configuration and a vendored ReXGlue SDK. Code generation creates C++ locally from the user’s extracted Xbox 360 executable, then builds the host executable.
ficha.compatibilidade: The documented target is Windows AMD64 with Git, CMake 3.25+, Ninja and Clang. Your extracted game folder must contain default.xex, XMediaFacade_default.xex and SpeechFacade_default.xex. No other operating system or console edition is documented as supported here.
ficha.progresso: The project reports that boot reaches the loading screen, where the main guest thread permanently waits on a kernel semaphore. Two separate boot/heap crash workarounds were added, but they do not resolve the semaphore blocker.
ficha.limitacoes: The game does not reach gameplay in the documented test. Races, career progression and content installation remain unverified, and the underlying cause of one guarded heap corruption is unknown. Building successfully must not be read as being able to play.
ficha.comoComecar: For development, follow the win-amd64-release CMake preset, run the forzahorizon2_codegen target and then forzahorizon2. Supply your extracted folder through --game_data_root. The README warns that launching the current result stops at the loading screen.

ficha.resumo: Static recompilation of the original Xbox version of Darkwatch using XboxXBERecomp, with Direct3D 12 rendering, mouse aiming and portable saves. Windows release v0.3 is available for community testing and requires your own supported North American Xbox ISO/XISO.
ficha.sobre: Darker Edition uses XboxXBERecomp for statically recompiled Xbox gameplay and a native Direct3D 12 renderer. The documented additions include mouse aiming, editable bindings, controller prompts and portable saves.
ficha.compatibilidade: Requires Windows 10 version 1903+ or Windows 11 x64, .NET Framework 4.8, an x86-64-v2 CPU with SSE4.2/POPCNT and a Direct3D 12 GPU with feature level 11_0. Setup verifies 23 files from a supported North American Xbox revision; other revisions and the PS2 disc are not accepted.
ficha.progresso: Public GitHub release recorded: v0.3, published 2026-10-18 (São Paulo time). A public release does not certify stability or complete gameplay.
ficha.limitacoes: Version 0.3 is for community testing. Full-campaign completion, online play, clean Windows installations and physical PS4/Switch controllers remain unverified. High-FPS event differences and shader/loading pauses may remain; extreme weapon FOV can expose the ends of models.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the Windows x64 player ZIP into a writable folder, open Darkwatch Darker Edition.exe and import your supported original Xbox ISO/XISO. Wait for import and shader preparation, then Play. For upgrades, use a fresh folder, copy GameData and run Import / Repair; keep the old folder until saves are checked.

fichaPt.resumo: Recompilação estática da versão original de Xbox de Darkwatch usando XboxXBERecomp, com renderização Direct3D 12, mira com mouse e saves portáteis. O release v0.3 para Windows está disponível para testes da comunidade e requer sua própria ISO/XISO norte-americana compatível do Xbox.
fichaPt.comoComecar: Extraia o ZIP do player de Windows x64 em uma pasta com permissão de escrita, abra o Darkwatch Darker Edition.exe e importe sua ISO/XISO original compatível do Xbox. Aguarde a importação e a preparação dos shaders, depois é só Jogar. Para atualizar, use uma pasta limpa, copie a pasta GameData e execute Import / Repair; guarde a pasta antiga até confirmar que os saves estão lá.

games.description: Foxhollow rebuilds Star Fox Adventures from the SFA decompilation with Aurora. Its desktop launcher manages updates, saves and a mod library while the player supplies the disc.

ficha.resumo: Foxhollow rebuilds Star Fox Adventures from the SFA decompilation with Aurora. Its desktop launcher manages updates, saves and a mod library while the player supplies the disc.
ficha.sobre: Foxhollow rebuilds Star Fox Adventures from the SFA decompilation with Aurora. Its desktop launcher manages updates, saves and a mod library while the player supplies the disc.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use your own original Star Fox Adventures disc. The maintainer reports Windows, Linux and macOS testing. Aurora’s underlying iOS/Android capability is explicitly not a planned Foxhollow release and is excluded from the target list.
ficha.progresso: The maintainer describes the desktop versions as fully playable. That remains an attributed statement and does not extend to mobile platforms or every mod combination.
ficha.limitacoes: Debug builds start without sound by default; the documented M toggle enables it. Replacing assets and patching functions is supported, but introducing entirely new models/animations/game objects has no easy path. The port aims to preserve original behavior, including bugs.
ficha.comoComecar: Use the official launcher linked at foxhollow.dev and supply your disc according to its guide. Developers can clone recursively and build with CMake 3.25+, Ninja and C++20, then start foxhollow with the disc path. Keep save backups before updates or mods.

games.title: Urban Reign
games.description: Static recompilation of Urban Reign for Windows, based on PS2Recomp and using the PCSX2 renderer. Version 1.3.0 documents CoopTool support for up to eight human players; your own USA disc image is required.

ficha.resumo: Static recompilation of Urban Reign for Windows, based on PS2Recomp and using the PCSX2 renderer. Version 1.3.0 documents CoopTool support for up to eight human players; your own USA disc image is required.
ficha.sobre: The PS2 game code is translated to C++ and compiled for Windows; the project uses the PCSX2 renderer for graphics, resolution settings and texture packs.
ficha.compatibilidade: Requires Windows 10/11 x64, an SSE4.1-capable CPU, a DirectX 11 GPU, WebView2 Runtime and your own USA disc image SLUS-21209.
ficha.progresso: Public GitHub release checked: v1.3.0, published 2026-10-13T23:39:49Z. Publication does not certify stability or complete gameplay.
ficha.limitacoes: In CoopTool, P5–P8 have no on-screen health bars; distinct move sets share four slots, and P7/P8 use P2’s character model. Eight-player support requires the documented multitap configuration.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the v1.3.0 package from GitHub Releases, open Urban Reign.exe, select your own compatible ISO in the Game tab and use PLAY. Consult the release notes for upgrades from 1.2.x.

fichaPt.resumo: Recompilação estática de Urban Reign para Windows, usando PSXRecomp e a renderização do PCSX2. A versão 1.3.0 traz suporte via CoopTool para até oito jogadores, mas você precisa ter a sua própria imagem de disco dos EUA.
fichaPt.sobre: O código do jogo de PS2 é traduzido para C++ e compilado para Windows; o projeto usa o renderizador do PCSX2 para gráficos, ajustes de resolução e pacotes de textura.
fichaPt.compatibilidade: Requer Windows 10/11 x64, uma CPU com suporte a SSE4.1, uma GPU DirectX 11, o WebView2 Runtime e a sua própria imagem de disco dos EUA SLUS-21209.
fichaPt.progresso: Release pública do GitHub verificada: v1.3.0, publicada em 13/10/2026 às 23:39:49Z. A publicação não garante estabilidade nem que o jogo possa ser concluído do início ao fim.
fichaPt.limitacoes: No CoopTool, os jogadores P5–P8 não têm barras de vida na tela; conjuntos de golpes diferentes dividem quatro espaços, e P7/P8 usam o modelo de personagem do P2. O suporte a oito jogadores exige a configuração de multitap documentada.
fichaPt.comoComecar: Extraia o pacote v1.3.0 lá dos GitHub Releases, abra o Urban Reign.exe, selecione sua ISO compatível na aba Game e mande ver no PLAY. Dá uma olhada nas notas de lançamento se for atualizar a partir da 1.2.x.

ficha.resumo: This ReXGlue/TRG project brings the XBLA HD Remix to a native Windows runtime, with local achievements, display settings and an experimental Linux AppImage.
ficha.sobre: This ReXGlue/TRG project brings the XBLA HD Remix to a native Windows runtime, with local achievements, display settings and an experimental Linux AppImage.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use your own STFS LIVE package, title 584108A4, media 37B7D7D3, version 0.0.1.3. Windows 10/11 x64 needs D3D12/VC++ x64; experimental Linux/Deck needs x86-64, glibc 2.31+ and Vulkan. The launcher refuses other executable versions.
ficha.progresso: The primary guide documents local saving, a 60-update-per-second simulation and offline achievement tracking; the non-Windows path remains experimental.
ficha.limitacoes: Online play is unsupported. Four ranked-online achievements cannot be earned through the offline achievement system. Real Linux/Steam Deck hardware validation is explicitly missing; do not equate the AppImage with a tested console-like experience.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the official package, open ssf2t_hd_remix.exe or its AppImage and choose Install from package on Play. Wait for Ready to play and press PLAY. Saves/settings/achievements are portable under user_data; reinstalling data preserves them as documented.

ficha.resumo: ReXGlue static recompilation of the Xbox 360 football game for Windows 10/11 x64. Imports your ISO or default.xex folder; installer and portable packages are available. Version 0.1.6 requires SSE4.2, not AVX2.
ficha.sobre: hosse translates the Xbox 360 game code to C++ with ReXGlue and compiles it into a Windows program. The launcher imports and checks the player’s game files, exposes controls/display options and offers updates from the official repository.
ficha.compatibilidade: Requires Windows 10 or 11 64-bit, an SSE4.2-capable processor, Direct3D 12 graphics with current drivers and your own Xbox 360 ISO or folder containing default.xex. A controller is recommended; keyboard mappings are on the launcher Controls page.
ficha.progresso: Release v0.1.6, published on 21 October 2026, also fixes a launcher crash while switching languages quickly. Earlier v0.1.5 notes add Portuguese/Spanish launcher text and fix a World Cup training-drill crash. A release is not an end-to-end tournament test by AllRecomps.
ficha.limitacoes: The v0.1.6 notes report frame-rate drops in pre-match scenes, replays and celebrations at both 1440p and 4K. Older/low-end PCs can lag. Downloadable packages are unsigned; this catalog’s source review is not an executable security audit.
ficha.comoComecar: Download the official setup executable or portable ZIP from Releases. Setup installs the app and opens the launcher; portable users extract the entire ZIP and run Launcher.exe. Select or drop your ISO/game folder into the launcher, wait for its checks and press Play. No game data is supplied.

ficha.resumo: Silent Hill 2’s PC executable statically recompiled for Switch ARM64, with compatibility for documented Enhanced Edition packs. Requires the exact supported executable and your game installation; shaders and high-frame-rate video decoding have limitations.
ficha.sobre: The PC x86 executable is translated ahead of time to C and compiled for ARM64. Windows interfaces such as Direct3D 8, DirectSound and input are reimplemented over SDL2, OpenGL and FFmpeg.
ficha.compatibilidade: The documented source is Director’s Cut / Restless Dreams with Enhanced Edition’s supported executable and essential packs. The README specifies a 5,685,248-byte sh2pc.exe and its SHA-1; an arbitrary PC executable is not interchangeable.
ficha.progresso: Official release observed: v1.01. This records a public project release, not proof of complete gameplay or a ready-to-run Switch game package.
ficha.limitacoes: First visits can stutter while shaders compile. The Switch may drop frames decoding the Enhanced Edition’s 60 FPS FMVs to preserve audio timing; this does not make the game itself run at 60 FPS.
ficha.comoComecar: Prepare your own PC installation with Enhanced Edition’s Enhanced Executable, Essential Files, Image Enhancement and Audio Enhancement packs. Copy the documented data/ and sh2e/ layout with sh2pc.exe and sh2-nx.nro into /switch/sh2-nx/.
ficha.notasPlataforma: This profile focuses on the Nintendo Switch build. See the repository for separately documented platforms.

ficha.resumo: Static recompilation of Xbox 360 Guitar Hero II for Linux x86-64 with Vulkan. Its AppImage rebuilds your USA game copy locally. The first pre-release supports controller and keyboard options, DLC and save export, with limited hardware testing.
ficha.sobre: reGH2 uses the ReXGlue SDK to statically recompile Guitar Hero II for Xbox 360 into a native Linux build. The AppImage includes the compiler and generates the game code from the user’s data on the user’s computer; the repository does not ship the original game.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use your own Xbox 360 USA copy, title ID 415607E7. The supported default.xex SHA-1 is b90b864487e6291761b207c8d0064e9a0779bdee. Input can be an ISO, extracted folder or default.xex. Other versions are refused by default.
ficha.progresso: The first public pre-release is v0.1.0, published on 2026-10-21 UTC. It includes reGH2-x86_64.AppImage and SHA256SUMS.txt. This catalog records release availability without classifying it as stable.
ficha.limitacoes: This is an early pre-release tested on one computer. The release notes explicitly list Steam Deck, other GPUs and the graphical launcher on other distributions as untested. Windows work has not started. Steam Deck appearing in requirements is not a verified-playability claim.
ficha.comoComecar: Download the official AppImage and verify it against SHA256SUMS.txt. Make it executable, run it, choose Select folder..., select your game files and press Install. After local compilation, press PLAY. Your GPU’s Vulkan driver must be installed on the host; bundled libraries do not replace it.
ficha.notasPlataforma: Linux x86-64 with glibc 2.35+ and Vulkan 1.2. SteamOS/Steam Deck are named in the requirements, but the initial release explicitly says Steam Deck was not tested. Windows development has not started.

fichaPt.comoComecar: Baixe o AppImage oficial e confira com o SHA256SUMS.txt. Deixe-o executável, abra, escolha "Selecionar pasta...", escolha os arquivos do seu jogo e clique em Instalar. Depois da compilação local, é só clicar em JOGAR. O driver Vulkan da sua placa de vídeo precisa estar instalado no sistema; as bibliotecas embutidas não substituem isso.

games.title: Monster Hunter Freedom Unite
games.description: Static recompilation of the European PSP Freedom Unite for Windows x64. Requires your own ULES01213 v1.01 ISO. Includes a launcher and experimental interpolated frames; online multiplayer and Linux are planned.

ficha.resumo: Static recompilation of the European PSP Freedom Unite for Windows x64. Requires your own ULES01213 v1.01 ISO. Includes a launcher and experimental interpolated frames; online multiplayer and Linux are planned.
ficha.sobre: MHForever statically recompiles the PSP program and reimplements console services for a native Windows application. The current module is Monster Hunter Freedom Unite; the project does not include or download the original game data.
ficha.compatibilidade: Only Windows 64-bit and the European Freedom Unite UMD release ULES01213, revision 1.01, are currently documented as supported. Supply your own legitimate, plain uncompressed ISO. Linux, Steam Deck, US/Japanese editions and other Monster Hunter games are future plans.
ficha.progresso: Release v0.2.2 was published on 2026-10-21. It fixes HUD participation in frame interpolation at 60 FPS and above. The maintainer reports single-player can be completed, but AllRecomps has not tested that claim.
ficha.limitacoes: The original game logic stays at 30 FPS. Optional 60–180 FPS modes interpolate rendered frames rather than running the simulation at those rates. These modes are experimental; the release recommends 60 or 90 for a safer choice because demanding scenes may not sustain higher output rates.
ficha.comoComecar: Download the Windows x64 ZIP from the official Releases page, extract it into a writable directory and run MHForever.exe. Add your uncompressed European ISO; the launcher checks and prepares its required files locally. Wait for preparation, then select Play. No emulator is required.

ficha.resumo: This Soulcalibur Dreamcast project uses dreamcomp to statically translate SH-4 code to C++, with Windows builds, configurable rendering, input remapping and virtual memory-card saves.
ficha.sobre: The repository identifies the 1999 USA Dreamcast game and documents static SH-4-to-C++ recompilation through dreamcomp. It is not a port of Soulcalibur II or a later entry.
ficha.compatibilidade: Windows is the current documented target. Linux, macOS and Android are listed as planned and are excluded from the supported-platform filters.
ficha.progresso: The README describes up to 4× internal resolution, keyboard/gamepad rebinding with F1 and a per-user virtual memory card. No complete-game test result is documented in this review.
ficha.limitacoes: Experimental anamorphic 16:9 widescreen currently crashes during fights and is disabled by default. The separate crop, letterbox and stretch display modes should not be confused with that option.
ficha.comoComecar: Build through the documented dreamcomp toolchain and provide your own USA T1401N V1.000 disc. The setup accepts Redump .cue/.bin, .gdi and .chd images and checks the expected boot file. Other editions are rejected.

ficha.resumo: Beta port of the PC Black Ops II decompilation to Nintendo Switch, using libnx and DXVK. Requires your Steam game files. Zombies and Multiplayer modes only; online is planned for Beta 2 and split screen is experimental.
ficha.sobre: Requiem ports a Ghidra decompilation of the Black Ops II PC executables to Nintendo Switch Horizon OS using devkitPro and libnx. The author describes AArch64 game code with 32-bit pointers inside a 64-bit NRO. DXVK translates the game’s Direct3D 11 graphics to Vulkan.
ficha.compatibilidade: Requires a Switch setup capable of running libnx homebrew and the player’s own Steam PC Black Ops II files. The release supports English only. No firmware/hardware compatibility matrix, storage minimum or complete game-file verification procedure is provided in the reviewed README/release.
ficha.progresso: Public Beta 1, tag 0.0.1, was published on 2026-10-21. The current scope covers Zombies and Multiplayer modes; limited mod support is documented, including an author report that DLC5 works. This does not establish compatibility with all mods or DLC.
ficha.limitacoes: Campaign is not included because the required decompilation is unfinished. Online play is announced for Beta 2, not available as a documented Beta 1 feature. A Multiplayer mode entry does not imply working internet multiplayer.
ficha.comoComecar: From the official Beta 1 release, extract t6game.zip into the SD card’s /switch/ directory so the application is /switch/t6game/t6game.nro. Place your Steam PC BO2 game files in /switch/t6game/. Launch t6game.nro through title takeover or a forwarder; the release also lists t6zm.nro and t6mp.nro as working entry points.

ficha.resumo: This N64Recomp-based edition of San Francisco Rush 2049 translates the Nintendo 64 game’s MIPS code to C, using RT64 for rendering, with desktop and browser builds.
ficha.sobre: The project uses static recompilation with N64Recomp, N64ModernRuntime and RT64. Its original game is the Nintendo 64 edition, not the Dreamcast release.
ficha.compatibilidade: The maintainer reports Windows gameplay. Linux builds in CI but is explicitly not play-tested. A separate browser build is documented for Chrome or Edge 113+; it is represented by Other in platform filters.
ficha.progresso: The author reports playable Windows races, Circuit, Ghost Race, Stunt and Battle, persistent Controller Pak saves and rendered split screen. Multiplayer has only been driven with one controller in the reported tests.
ficha.limitacoes: Native .nrm mods are supported but untested. The browser build omits mods, MSAA and HDR; clearing the site’s browser storage removes its ROM copy, settings and saves.
ficha.comoComecar: Provide your own US .z64 ROM with SHA-1 3f99351d7bb61656614bdb2aa1a90cfe55d1922c. Extract the Windows release and open Rush2049Recompiled.exe, then select Load ROM if the file is not found. Other regions and revisions are unsupported.
ficha.notasPlataforma: Windows play-tested by the author; Linux CI build untested in gameplay; Other denotes the separate browser build.

fichaPt.resumo: Esta edição de San Francisco Rush 2049 baseada em N64Recomp traduz o código MIPS do jogo de Nintendo 64 para C, usando RT64 para renderização, com versões para desktop e navegador.
fichaPt.sobre: O projeto usa recompilação estática com N64Recomp, N64ModernRuntime e RT64. O jogo original é a versão de Nintendo 64, e não a de Dreamcast.
fichaPt.compatibilidade: O desenvolvedor testou a jogabilidade no Windows. As versões para Linux rodam no CI, mas sem testes práticos de jogo. Tem uma versão para navegador documentada para o Chrome ou Edge 113+; ela aparece como "Other" nos filtros de plataforma.
fichaPt.progresso: O criador relata corridas jogáveis no Windows nos modos Circuit, Ghost Race, Stunt e Battle, além de saves funcionais no Controller Pak e tela dividida renderizada. O multiplayer só foi testado usando um único controle nos testes reportados.
fichaPt.limitacoes: Mods nativos em .nrm são suportados, mas não testados. A versão de navegador não tem suporte a mods, MSAA e HDR; apagar os dados do site no navegador vai apagar a cópia da ROM, as configurações e os saves.
fichaPt.comoComecar: Traga sua própria ROM .z64 americana com o SHA-1 3f99351d7bb61656614bdb2aa1a90cfe55d1922c. Extraia o release de Windows, abra o arquivo Rush2049Recompiled.exe e clique em "Load ROM" caso o arquivo não seja encontrado automaticamente. Outras regiões e revisões não são suportadas.
fichaPt.notasPlataforma: Joguinho testado no Windows pelo criador; a build de Linux do CI não foi testada na jogabilidade; e "Other" indica a versão separada para navegador.

ficha.resumo: An experimental recompilation of the Nintendo 64 version of 40 Winks using N64Recomp, N64ModernRuntime and RT64. Windows and Linux alpha builders verify your own supported USA ROM and compile the playable game locally. Split screen, saves and display options are documented.
ficha.sobre: The project generates translated CPU sources locally with N64Recomp and links N64ModernRuntime and RT64. The public downloads are ROM-free first-launch builders, rather than a package containing the original game or generated game program.
ficha.compatibilidade: The Windows setup targets Windows 10/11 x64 and a Direct3D 12 or Vulkan GPU, with internet and several GB for compilation. Linux uses a self-building AppImage and needs the development packages in the build guide. Both require the supported clean, big-endian USA .z64 ROM.
ficha.progresso: The v0.1.7-alpha notes describe locally generated native audio, fullscreen-effect fixes and true top-and-bottom split screen. The README reports gameplay, cutscenes, Controller Pak saves and controller support; these are project reports, not independent AllRecomps testing.
ficha.limitacoes: The downloads are alpha prereleases. Minor widescreen edge-geometry issues may remain. The first launch downloads tools/dependencies and compiles from your ROM, so it is not an instant game install; Linux and Windows have different setup requirements.
ficha.comoComecar: Use the setup for your OS, select the supported ROM and destination, then wait for verification and local generation/compilation. Keep access to the ROM because assets are read from it at runtime. For alpha upgrades, rebuild through the updated builder as instructed in the release notes.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto IV + Episodes
games.description: Xbox 360 GTA IV and Episodes from Liberty City recompiled for a homebrew-enabled PS5. Based on Liberty Recompiled; requires the USA disc and Title Update 8. Includes DualSense features and a game-selection hub.

projects.name: Grand Theft Auto IV + Episodes — PS5

ficha.resumo: Xbox 360 GTA IV and Episodes from Liberty City recompiled for a homebrew-enabled PS5. Based on Liberty Recompiled; requires the USA disc and Title Update 8. Includes DualSense features and a game-selection hub.
ficha.sobre: elripalda ports Liberty Recompiled, through the LibertyRecompAndroid fork and ReXGlue, to PlayStation 5. The supported games are GTA IV, The Lost and Damned and The Ballad of Gay Tony. The source is Xbox 360; PS5 is the destination, not the original game platform.
ficha.compatibilidade: Requires a PS5 that can run homebrew from /data/homebrew/, about 17 GB free, your own USA Xbox 360 GTA IV ISO and Title Update 8. Episodes require their own Xbox 360 packages. The documentation does not establish a general firmware compatibility matrix.
ficha.progresso: The public v1.0 release was published on 21 October 2026. The maintainer reports a 60 FPS cap at 4K, with the busiest streets dropping into the high 40s and 50s. These are author reports, not an AllRecomps benchmark.
ficha.limitacoes: Only the USA disc with Title Update 8 is documented as supported. A locked 60 FPS in the busiest streets is a v1.1 goal, not an existing guarantee. Moving Frame Generation out of experimental status is also future work in the v1.0 release notes.
ficha.comoComecar: For manual setup, extract PPSA94004.zip and copy PPSA94004 to /data/homebrew/ on the PS5. Put your USA ISO and Title Update 8 in /data/homebrew/PPSA94004/install/, launch the app and press X on Home. The files can be removed after installation. A running payload loader speeds up installation; the guide also describes the slower path without it.
