ficha.compatibilidade: Use your USA Rev 1 or supported Europe En/De or Fr/It ROM. Windows 10/11 x64 requires D3D12 or Vulkan; Linux needs glibc 2.34+ and Vulkan. .z64/.n64/.v64 byte orders are accepted.
ficha.progresso: The guide documents three ROM revisions, language differences and widescreen rendering. Regional single-player differences remain those of the original editions.
ficha.limitacoes: Version 1.0 can run at double speed with the game’s High resolution setting in fullscreen on high-refresh monitors; use Low there. The README says 1.1+ handles this automatically. Rumble and controller remapping are not implemented.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the Windows ZIP and run ISS2000Recompiled.exe with its DLLs, or run the official Linux AppImage. Select your supported ROM and configure graphics. Saves/settings use APPDATA/iss2000recomp on Windows or .local/share/iss2000recomp on Linux.

games.description: Experimental Master System-to-Windows static recompilation with a Portuguese interface, remappable controls and deterministic saves. Requires the Brazilian ROM; documented routes reach the second stage, without full-game validation.

projects.name: Mônica no Castelo do Dragão — Recomp

ficha.resumo: Experimental Master System-to-Windows static recompilation with a Portuguese interface, remappable controls and deterministic saves. Requires the Brazilian ROM; documented routes reach the second stage, without full-game validation.
ficha.sobre: The project studies Z80-to-C static recompilation with a runtime modeling the Master System’s hardware. It checks the current bytes and stops when it reaches code outside the compiled coverage, rather than silently falling back to interpretation.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use the Brazilian ROM, 262144 bytes, CRC32 01D67C0B and SHA-256 484FDF3CB85C1BFD1CA938CFD59FD582A06EE20F9F3686BB3DFD1F7A70193086. The portable release targets Windows x64; suggested CPU/RAM minimums are estimates, not certified requirements.
ficha.progresso: Release v0.10.0 documents opening, first door, first boss, second-stage arrival and an 18500-frame exploration route. The AOT candidate count includes potential data offsets and is explicitly not a percentage of real code coverage.
ficha.limitacoes: The full game is not validated. 16:9 currently uses preserved framing or crop, not additional scenery. Save loading reconstructs recorded inputs rather than restoring an instant snapshot and can take longer for long sessions.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the entire official Windows ZIP and open MonicaRecomp.exe with SDL3.dll and assets beside it. Select your compatible ROM to enable Play; a development compiler is not required for this portable package.

games.title: Super Mario All-Stars
games.description: Cross-platform Super Mario All-Stars project with a launcher, controller mapping and save states. Uses the 2010 25th Anniversary ROM; SMB and Lost Levels are mostly recompiled, while SMB2 and SMB3 use an embedded interpreter.

ficha.resumo: Cross-platform Super Mario All-Stars project with a launcher, controller mapping and save states. Uses the 2010 25th Anniversary ROM; SMB and Lost Levels are mostly recompiled, while SMB2 and SMB3 use an embedded interpreter.
ficha.sobre: Built on snesrecomp and recomp-ui, this is a hybrid collection: Super Mario Bros. and The Lost Levels are mostly native-translated, while Super Mario Bros. 2 and 3 execute original code in an embedded interpreter. It is not four fully statically recompiled games.
ficha.compatibilidade: The accepted .sfc is Super Mario All-Stars USA, 25th Anniversary re-release (2010), SHA-256 411c7036750fbc79d60b84602414dbe713074de8204d3c4a5ad762679c103c61. The ordinary 1993 USA cartridge is explicitly rejected.
ficha.progresso: Release v0.2.0 includes Windows, Linux, Mac and Android downloads. Features include integer scaling, configurable input, save/load states, individual sound-voice mute and optional cheats. A public package does not prove every game or controller was independently tested.
ficha.limitacoes: Controller recognition through SDL databases is not a per-device validation guarantee. The collection’s interpretation/recompilation split and strict ROM revision are material compatibility limits; do not substitute another dump because the title is the same.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the desktop package and run SuperMarioAllStars, or install the official Android APK. Select your compatible .sfc when prompted and confirm ROM verified, then configure options and Play. No ROM is included.

fichaPt.sobre: Construído sobre o snesrecomp e o recomp-ui, este é um pacote híbrido: Super Mario Bros. e The Lost Levels rodam praticamente traduzidos de forma nativa, enquanto Super Mario Bros. 2 e 3 executam o código original em um interpretador embutido. Não são quatro jogos totalmente recompilados de forma estática.
fichaPt.compatibilidade: O arquivo .sfc aceito é o Super Mario All-Stars USA, relançamento de 25º aniversário (2010), com SHA-256 411c7036750fbc79d60b84602414dbe713074de8204d3c4a5ad762679c103c61. O cartucho comum de 1993 dos EUA é rejeitado de cara.
fichaPt.progresso: O release v0.2.0 traz downloads para Windows, Linux, Mac e Android. Entre os recursos estão escala inteira, controles configuráveis, salvamento/carregamento de estados, mudo por canal de áudio e cheats opcionais. Um pacote público não garante que cada jogo ou controle foi testado individualmente.
fichaPt.limitacoes: O reconhecimento de controle via banco de dados SDL não é uma garantia de validação por dispositivo. A divisão entre interpretação/recompilação da coleção e a revisão rigorosa da ROM são limites reais de compatibilidade; não coloque outro dump no lugar só porque o título é o mesmo.

ficha.resumo: Static native recompilation of Theme Park SNES for Windows x64, requiring the verified European PAL ROM; original 4:3 presentation.
ficha.sobre: The game’s S-CPU and SPC700 instructions execute through ahead-of-time native code, with no runtime CPU interpreter, JIT or emulator fallback. Graphics/audio are computed live.
ficha.compatibilidade: The Windows x64 build uses statically linked SDL3 and Visual C++ runtime. Runtime needs Windows system components rather than the development toolchain; source builds require Visual Studio 2022 C++, Windows SDK and CMake 3.20+.
ficha.progresso: The latest non-prerelease GitHub release observed is v1.0.0. A release does not establish stability, complete gameplay or tested platform support.
ficha.limitacoes: Version 1.0.0 presents the original 4:3 picture; widescreen is unfinished and paused because experimental runs produced audio stuttering/crackling. Remaining audio artifacts cannot all be attributed to the original ROM.
ficha.comoComecar: Supply Theme Park Europe (En,Fr,De), unheadered PAL .sfc, 1048576 bytes, SHA-256 c0a7e27131a7d8c9ef52a5227329e6de5846c045a9da1f3f84845e3be8e4efba. Extract the whole release and select the ROM in Launcher.exe.

fichaPt.resumo: Recompilação nativa estática de Theme Park do SNES para Windows x64, exigindo a ROM PAL europeia verificada; mantém a proporção original 4:3.
fichaPt.sobre: As instruções S-CPU e SPC700 do jogo rodam via código nativo compilado antecipadamente (AOT), sem interpretador de CPU em tempo de execução, JIT ou fallback de emulador. Gráficos e áudio são processados na hora.
fichaPt.compatibilidade: A build de Windows x64 usa SDL3 vinculado estaticamente e o runtime do Visual C++. A execução precisa dos componentes de sistema do Windows em vez da ferramenta de desenvolvimento; compilar a partir do código-fonte exige o Visual Studio 2022 C++, Windows SDK e CMake 3.20+.
fichaPt.progresso: A última release oficial (não pré-lançamento) vista no GitHub é a v1.0.0. Uma release não garante estabilidade, gameplay completo ou suporte testado a plataformas.
fichaPt.limitacoes: A versão 1.0.0 traz a imagem original em 4:3; o widescreen está incompleto e foi pausado porque os testes experimentais geraram engasgos e chiados no áudio. Nem todos os problemas de áudio restantes são culpa da ROM original.
fichaPt.comoComecar: Providencie o Theme Park Europe (En,Fr,De), a ROM .sfc PAL sem cabeçalho, com 1048576 bytes e SHA-256 c0a7e27131a7d8c9ef52a5227329e6de5846c045a9da1f3f84845e3be8e4efba. Extraia o release inteiro e selecione a ROM no Launcher.exe.

projects.name: Tomb Raider I / II / III — TRX
systems: oct 11, 2026 catalog platform notes windows / linux / macos

ficha.resumo: An open-source reimplementation of Tomb Raider I, II and III in a shared engine, with customizable controls and visual enhancements.
ficha.sobre: TRX is a single open-source engine for Tomb Raider I, II and III and custom levels, aiming to preserve each original engine’s distinct mechanics through decompilation and replacement of proprietary components.
ficha.compatibilidade: The README explicitly lists Windows, Linux and macOS as currently supported platforms. Android is mentioned in a question, but is not included in the supported-platform answer.
ficha.progresso: The authors state that Tomb Raider I, II and III are playable from beginning to end and request bug reports when problems occur. This documents the upstream claim; AllRecomps has not independently played through the games.
ficha.limitacoes: HD texture-pack support is listed as not currently planned. Tomb Raider IV work is described as early and is not presented as fully supported alongside I, II and III.
ficha.comoComecar: The official README directs installation to docs/trx/INSTALLING.md and links the release list excluding prereleases. Consult that guide for the current installer and game-data instructions for your chosen title.

fichaPt.resumo: Uma recriação open-source de Tomb Raider I, II e III numa engine compartilhada, com controles personalizáveis e melhorias visuais.
fichaPt.sobre: O TRX é uma engine de código aberto única para Tomb Raider I, II e III e fases personalizadas, com o objetivo de preservar as mecânicas únicas de cada engine original através de descompilação e substituição de componentes proprietários.
fichaPt.compatibilidade: O README lista claramente Windows, Linux e macOS como plataformas compatíveis no momento. O Android é citado em uma dúvida, mas ficou de fora da resposta sobre plataformas suportadas.
fichaPt.progresso: Os autores afirmam que Tomb Raider I, II e III são jogáveis do início ao fim e pedem que você mande um bug report se rolar algum problema. Isso é só o que dizem lá no projeto oficial, hein? A equipe do AllRecomps não jogou tudo do começo ao fim para testar.
fichaPt.limitacoes: O suporte a pacotes de texturas HD não está nos planos por enquanto. O trampo em Tomb Raider IV ainda está no começo, então ele não entra na lista dos jogos com suporte total igual ao I, II e III.
fichaPt.comoComecar: O README oficial manda instalar seguindo docs/trx/INSTALLING.md e traz o link com as releases (sem contar as pré-releases). Dá uma olhada lá para ver o instalador atual e os passos de dados do jogo escolhido.

projects.name: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection — BilalReloaded

ficha.resumo: A Windows runtime for the PS4 Nathan Drake Collection: the original game code runs on the CPU while a game-specific PS4 compatibility layer and shadPS4-derived Vulkan renderer handle system and graphics work.
ficha.sobre: This project targets the PS4 collection containing Drake’s Fortune, Among Thieves and Drake’s Deception. It is not a port of the later Legacy of Thieves collection.
ficha.compatibilidade: layer Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection — BilalReloaded A Windows runtime for the PS4 Nathan Drake Collection: the original game code runs on the CPU while a game-specific PS4 compatibility layer and shadPS4-derived Vulkan renderer handle system and graphics work. Playable Windows Official documentation ↗ Release page ↗ Source ↗ · Artwork of the original game; it does not demonstrate this port’s compatibility.
ficha.progresso: The developer reports gameplay in all three games, collection-menu switching, saves, audio, movies and controllers. Uncharted 3 has received less play testing; the README does not certify full campaign completion.
ficha.limitacoes: Experimental multithreaded rendering with two queued frames may crash Uncharted 2; the README recommends one queued frame or leaving multithreading disabled. Uncharted 2’s busiest scenes remain CPU-bound.
ficha.comoComecar: Extract the official Uncharted-windows.zip, open Uncharted Launcher.exe and select your own decrypted CUSA02344 game folder containing eboot.bin and sce_sys. Choose a game and preset, then Play.

fichaPt.progresso: O desenvolvedor relata gameplay nos três jogos, alternância no menu da coletânea, saves, áudio, vídeos e controles. Uncharted 3 recebeu menos testes; o README não garante que a campanha inteira possa ser concluída.

fichaPt.comoComecar: Extraia o arquivo oficial Uncharted-windows.zip, abra o Uncharted Launcher.exe e selecione a sua pasta descriptografada do jogo CUSA02344 contendo o eboot.bin e a pasta sce_sys. Escolha um jogo e um preset, e clique em Play.

games.title: Demon's Souls
games.description: This ps3recomp-based project translates Demon’s Souls PPU/SPU code to C and links replacement PS3 services with a Direct3D 12 renderer. Its documented player coverage reaches early Boletaria.

ficha.resumo: This ps3recomp-based project translates Demon’s Souls PPU/SPU code to C and links replacement PS3 services with a Direct3D 12 renderer. Its documented player coverage reaches early Boletaria.
ficha.sobre: This ps3recomp-based project translates Demon’s Souls PPU/SPU code to C and links replacement PS3 services with a Direct3D 12 renderer. Its documented player coverage reaches early Boletaria.
ficha.compatibilidade: Use your own USA BLUS30443 dump. The source workflow requires Windows 10/11/D3D12, Visual Studio/LLVM Clang, CMake/Ninja, Python and Git Bash; RPCS3 decrypts your EBOOT.BIN. The SPURS path additionally requires your own decrypted firmware libsre.prx.
ficha.progresso: The source reports title, character creation, tutorial, Nexus and Boletarian Palace 1-1 with saves and audio. That is early-level coverage, not a complete-game compatibility guarantee.
ficha.limitacoes: The full campaign is not validated. Transparent effects can disappear for single frames; high FPS can change scene timing and physics above 60 is untested. Keep the original cap when diagnosing behavior and never include firmware/game files in public reports.
ficha.comoComecar: Follow the ordered README build steps with the documented ps3recomp fork: decrypt locally, analyze/lift PPU, apply boot patches, generate SPU jobs and compile. Set PS3VFSROOT in your local configuration and use tools/des/play.sh. This is a multi-step developer setup.

fichaPt.compatibilidade: Use seu próprio dump dos EUA BLUS30443. O fluxo de trabalho de origem exige Windows 10/11/D3D12, Visual Studio/LLVM Clang, CMake/Ninja, Python e Git Bash; o RPCS3 descriptografa seu EBOOT.BIN. O caminho do SPURS também requer suas próprias bibliotecas de firmware descriptografadas libsre.prx.
fichaPt.progresso: A fonte relata título, criação de personagem, tutorial, Nexus e Boletarian Palace 1-1 com salvamentos e áudio. Isso é cobertura de nível inicial, e não uma garantia de compatibilidade com o jogo completo.
fichaPt.limitacoes: A campanha completa não foi validada. Efeitos transparentes podem sumir por quadros únicos; FPS alto pode alterar a sincronização de cenas e a física acima de 60 não foi testada. Mantenha o limite original ao diagnosticar o comportamento e nunca inclua arquivos de firmware ou de jogo em relatórios públicos.
fichaPt.comoComecar: Siga os passos de compilação ordenados do README com o fork documentado do ps3recomp: descriptografe localmente, analise/converta o PPU, aplique patches de inicialização, gere tarefas de SPU e compile. Defina PS3VFSROOT na sua configuração local e use tools/des/play.sh. Esta é uma configuração de desenvolvedor com várias etapas.

ficha.resumo: An early Mac preview that generates 2Xtreme from the user’s PlayStation disc with PSXRecomp; controller support and broad gameplay validation remain pending.
ficha.sobre: The app generates native game code locally from the user’s disc using PSXRecomp and a bundled compiler; game code and a retail BIOS are not distributed.
ficha.compatibilidade: Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26+. Supported disc is 2Xtreme USA SCUS-94508; CUE/BIN includes music, standalone BIN/ISO does not, and CHD is unsupported.

ficha.progresso: The maintainer describes the game as playable and in development, with testing through Go to Longhouse, plus working saves, audio and motion/touchpad input simulation. This is not a complete-game compatibility claim.

ficha.comoComecar: Supply your own decrypted USA CUSA00223 base game 1.00 merged with update 1.07, including the update’s eboot.bin and game modules. The documented game data occupies about 33 GB and no firmware files are required.

games.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
games.description: Ahead-of-time recompilation of Nintendo Switch AArch64 CPU code to native x86-64 (and AArch64 hosts), using suyu's HLE stack for everything

projects.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
systems: oct 19, 2026 catalog platform notes current native integration: documented windows toolchain. earlier windows/linux/macos results in the readme are a separate historical suyu-hosted track.

ficha.resumo: The mk8-recomp project is developing a standalone Mario Kart 8 Deluxe runtime using statically translated CPU code and native Vulkan graphics. Its documented Windows integration has completed limited race tests; no native release or download is available. Earlier suyu-hosted results describe a separate historical track.
ficha.sobre: The current native integration adapts the Belmante runtime and AArch64-to-C++ recompiler. This is distinct from the older suyu-hosted static CPU exporter; historical emulator performance is not evidence of the new native runtime’s performance.
ficha.compatibilidade: The integration guide documents a Windows native toolchain and Vulkan graphics. The older Windows, Linux and Apple silicon measurements in the main README belong to the historical suyu track, so they are not listed here as verified platforms for the current native build.
ficha.progresso: According to the project’s local reports, a three-lap Stadium race, first-place results and save/restart checks have completed; a later run reached Water Park’s second lap. These are bounded developer observations, not an AllRecomps playtest or a complete-cup certification.
ficha.limitacoes: Sustained full-speed performance, human listening, physical-controller testing and broader race/cup coverage remain open. The native-foundations prereleases were removed; old release numbers and historical 60 FPS claims must not be presented as an available native game.
ficha.comoComecar: There is no current native player download to install. Developers should read the native integration and build notes before attempting a source build with their own game inputs. Historical suyu setup instructions explicitly do not validate a clean build of the new native checkpoint.
ficha.notasPlataforma: Current native integration: documented Windows toolchain. Earlier Windows/Linux/macOS results in the README are a separate historical suyu-hosted track.

games.title: Pokémon Brilliant Diamond
games.description: Unity source-reconstruction project for Brilliant Diamond 1.3.0 on Windows. Rebuilds from your own Switch dump with Unity 2019 and Wwise. Beta editor/standalone gameplay is reported, but large parts remain untested; no prebuilt game release is provided.

ficha.resumo: Unity source-reconstruction project for Brilliant Diamond 1.3.0 on Windows. Rebuilds from your own Switch dump with Unity 2019 and Wwise. Beta editor/standalone gameplay is reported, but large parts remain untested; no prebuilt game release is provided.
ficha.sobre: uDPR reconstructs Brilliant Diamond as a Unity project, with C# declarations recovered from IL2CPP metadata and method bodies restored from decompiled machine code. The standalone Windows build compiles that C# with IL2CPP and rebuilds asset bundles for Windows. This is not a byte-identical recovery of the original source or an emulator.
ficha.compatibilidade: Requires Windows 10/11 x64 on SSD, Unity 2019.4.27f1, Wwise 2019.2.5.7349 with Windows SDK components, and your own Brilliant Diamond v1.3.0 dump with exefs/main and romfs/Data. Standalone builds additionally require Unity Windows Build Support (IL2CPP) and Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools.
ficha.progresso: The README labels the project beta and reports booting, playing and saving in both Unity editor and a standalone Windows build. No GitHub release was available in this review: the documented distribution path is to prepare the project and build from your own data, not download a finished game.
ficha.limitacoes: Large parts of the game have not been played through on PC. Only Brilliant Diamond v1.3.0 is supported; Shining Pearl and other versions are not. Linux/macOS porting possibilities are not existing validated targets. Fast-forward offers 2x–8x but achieved speed depends on frame throughput; contests, Poffin cooking and movies stay at normal speed.
ficha.comoComecar: Download the reviewed repository source and run setup.cmd. Select your own extracted dump, provide the required Wwise integration through the official launcher and let setup export/rebuild assets. It downloads pinned tools and checks checksums. The author estimates about three hours on a high-end PC; rerunning resumes the work after a failure.
